label: win: sign hidden by van
driver_story: I parked on the street. The only sign for the zone was completely hidden behind a parked delivery van, I could not see it from my car. I photographed the van covering the sign right after I found the ticket.
evidence: Photo of the van hiding the sign
Photo of where the car was parked
why: sign not visible from where the car stood

label: win: entrance signage missing (private)
driver_story: There is no sign at the entrance to the car park. The only sign is a small faded one far inside. I took photos of the entrance the same day.
evidence: Photos of the entrance without a sign
Photo of the faded sign inside
why: entrance signage missing is the strongest private ground

label: win: observation period not respected
driver_story: I arrived at 13:19, walked to the payment machine and paid at 13:22. The ticket says 13:20. One minute after I stopped the car.
why: ticket within 1-2 minutes of arrival, receipt proves it

label: win: loading/unloading
driver_story: I stopped for two minutes to unload a washing machine to the shop door. The street is parking prohibited but stopping is allowed. The shop has a delivery note with the time.
why: standsning not parkering; medium because duration must be proven; rulebook lists it under WIN

label: win: paid in app, plate typo
driver_story: I paid in the app for the whole afternoon but typed AB 12 354 instead of AB 12 345. Receipt attached.
why: payment exists, plate off by one character, kulance

label: win: payment covers ticket time
driver_story: I had a valid ticket from the machine from 12:00 to 15:00. The fine was issued at 13:20. The paper ticket had slipped off the dashboard onto the floor but I still have it.
why: receipt timestamp covers the ticket timestamp

label: win: resident permit displayed
driver_story: I have a valid resident permit for this zone and it was in the windscreen, clearly visible. I have a photo of it in the car taken when I found the fine.
evidence: Photo of the permit in the windscreen
why: valid permit displayed and visible

label: win: medical emergency documented
driver_story: My passenger collapsed and I pulled over and ran into the pharmacy for help, then we went to the emergency room. I have the hospital note from that afternoon.
why: documented emergency usually wins but is discretionary; rulebook lists it under WIN

label: win: formally defective fine
driver_story: The fine shows plate AB 12 346, mine is AB 12 345, and the operator sent no photo documentation when I asked.
evidence: Operator's email saying no photos exist
why: wrong plate and no photo

label: win: p-skive set correctly
driver_story: I arrived at 13:05 and set the p-skive to 13:15 as the rule says. The 2 hour limit ran to 15:15 and the fine was issued at 14:50 claiming the disc was wrong. I have a photo of the disc at 13:15.
why: disc set to next quarter hour after arrival is correct

label: lose: didn't see a clear sign
driver_story: I just didn't see the sign. It was there and normal, I was in a hurry.
why: clear standard sign, not seeing it is no ground

label: lose: a few minutes over
driver_story: My ticket ran out at 13:12 and the fine was issued at 13:20. Only eight minutes over, that is unreasonable.
why: no grace period beyond observation

label: lose: everyone parks there
driver_story: Everyone parks on that corner, I did not know it was not allowed. There were five other cars.
why: not knowing rules / everyone does it is no ground

label: lose: p-skive forgotten
driver_story: I forgot to set the p-skive. I was only shopping for 40 minutes, under the 2 hour limit anyway.
why: forgotten disc loses

label: lose: fire lane
driver_story: I stopped in the fire lane in front of the block for 20 minutes to carry boxes up to the third floor.
why: fire lane without exemption loses

label: lose: paid wrong zone code
driver_story: I paid in the app but chose zone 2041 instead of 2014. I did pay, the money went to the same operator.
why: payment for the wrong area code loses

label: lose: fine blew away
driver_story: I never found the fine on my car, it must have blown away. Now they add a reminder fee. The operator has a photo of it under the wiper.
why: operator photo proves placement

label: trap: sympathetic story, no evidence
driver_story: I am a single parent and was rushing to pick up my sick child from daycare. I am sure the sign was not clear but I did not take any photos. 850 kr is a lot for us.
why: no evidence at all, story alone

label: trap: terse story with receipt
driver_story: Paid. Receipt attached. Plate typo one letter.
evidence: App payment receipt covering 12:00-16:00, plate AB 12 346
why: evidence beats prose

label: trap: handicap bay, sympathetic story
driver_story: I parked in the handicap bay for ten minutes because my grandmother cannot walk far and we were visiting the doctor. I do not have a handicap permit but she clearly needed it.
why: handicap bay without permit loses regardless of story
